blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Batangas 1st District Rep. Leandro Leviste has posted P72,000 bail at the Makati Regional Trial Court over his case of alleged violation of the Public Service Act, according to NBI Director Melvin Matibag. “He posted bail. I received an order from the court that he posted the bail through cash. A representative was sent, including those of his co-accused,” Matibag said. “So technically, he’s now under the jurisdiction of the court – the RTC (regional trial court), court of Makati.
